title: lomatium minus
intro: Lomatium minus, commonly known as Lomatium or Biscuit Root, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as respiratory infections and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium minus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium minus work together to provide its medicinal properties, which have been used by indigenous communities for centuries to promote overall health and well-being.
